A full card image with the corrected text set into the card and a small bronze disc at the bottom right, beside the game-text box, marking it as errata. The Players Committee showed it in its online card lists; the earliest saved copy is from 19 November 2016.

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Hoth-D-blizzard1-PC-Errata-disc-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[Blizzard 1 (PC Errata 2013 slip)]] (16 April 2013): The wording differs from the 2013 slip: “Landspeed may not be increased.” is the last sentence, after “adds 1 to total.”, and “Cannon” keeps its capital C as on the printed card: “May add 2 pilots and 8 passengers. Immune to attrition &lt; 4. When using AT-AT Cannon to Target The Main Generator, adds 1 to total. Landspeed may not be increased.” This is a full card image with the printed art, lore and title. There is no title strip and no “E”; a small round bronze disc sits at the lower right corner of the game-text box frame.

The 2013 slip and the same area of the disc image, scaled to the slip's width; nothing else is edited.
